title: Orinoco Generational Scavenge & Mark-Sweep
description: Observe Young Generation semi-space evacuation and Old Generation promotion.

steps.label: 1. Bump-Pointer Allocation
steps.description: New short-lived objects allocate sequentially in Young Generation From-space.

steps.label: 2. Parallel Scavenge
steps.description: GC traces from Stack and Global roots; live objects evacuate to To-space, dead objects vanish without per-object free.

steps.label: 3. Promotion & Concurrent Mark
steps.description: Objects surviving two scavenges promote to Old Generation, marked concurrently by background threads.
